'''Al'art''' was a [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]], and a so-called "Royal Forces Vindicator." Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Al'art was seen on patrol in a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="SWG:NS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCivilian.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of General Al'art]]
Al'art appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> General Al'art was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:NS" />
